blockedBy: Upstream tests/FeedbackFormTests.cs::RelayConfiguration and tests/FeedbackRepliesTests.cs assert the shipped relay is live. Enabling this requires rewriting those tests first. Left off by user decision: '其他的就沿用现在的'.
template: internal const string Url=""; // LeoZhang fork: upstream Deno relay disabled; feedback opens this fork's issue form in a browser.
rationale: The upstream relay (myfinder-feedback-relay.wushuai0802.deno.net) creates issues in wushuai0802's repository. A public build published by LeoZhang must not silently send its users' diagnostics to the original author's service. An empty relay is a supported upstream code path: the form switches to browser submission.
compliance: Keeps the feedback feature usable, but routes it to the publisher's own issue tracker (see feedback-issue-base). Does not remove any upstream notice.
note: The pattern uses [^"]* so it still matches the empty value on a replay, making this patch idempotent.
